ctx.x: The entertainers. Yeah. 101, they called it. Well, anyhow.

Two, three people had it. That's when Beansy had it. It took five of them. Beansy, Folio, Mika, Big John. Caris Pritch used to hang around there. Five of them had it at one club. So Beansy got in with that story. That story. So he said to me, I went around, he was looking for me. He said, Manny, I want your band to play. Play over here at that story. Got a job, he'll rehearse him. I mean, advertise on Sundays and play three or four times a week. I said, well, I'm not playing. He said, I want you to get Buddy…
